risk_note: RV2 by path (apps/admin globs match the funds rule; no money logic). Admin login and shell rebuilt on antd 5.29.3 components per plan 03 §9.1 (couli#102): Layout / Sider / Header / Content, Menu (groups, selected key follows the route, links kept inside menu items), Breadcrumb, Tag, Button type=link, Result / Empty / Card; login steps on Form / Form.Item (local and data.fields errors through validateStatus / help), Input / Input.Password (toggle is an antd Button with the original Chinese names and aria-pressed), Steps, Alert (info alerts role=note), Avatar, Typography, QRCode; OTP input wraps a single antd Input (maxLength 6, inputMode numeric, autocomplete one-time-code) with six visual cells; inline SVG icons replaced by @ant-design/icons; handwritten CSS cut from about 990 to 150 non-empty lines of layout only, colours through theme.ts token mapping (info colours mapped to neutral tokens). pages/login/media-query.ts installs a never-matching matchMedia only when the API is missing (jsdom), because antd Form / Steps call it on mount and a frozen jsdom test does not stub it. Rule tests by Codex in two calls (round 2 after the Claude spec-test review S1: hand-built ant-* lookalikes), red first in the container (red/2, 23 tests). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in four rounds (round 2: two Codex S2 plus theme / props design tuning; round 3: OTP hit area S2; round 4, released by the orchestrator: typing no longer re-renders the whole login page). The remaining jsdom slowness of antd (CSS-in-JS and getComputedStyle) is handled by F1-06s (#407, rule-test timeout 15 s). Reviews: Codex only (approvals id 27). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with two S2 (password toggle not keyboard-operable, Cmd/Ctrl click swallowed), round 2 pass with one S2 (OTP hit area), both fixed; round 3 pass with one S2 (Steps lost the step-list name and aria-current, moved to ledger F1-06r); round 4 (extra round released by the orchestrator for the jsdom performance regression, blocked B-14) pass with the same S2 only

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents; round 1 fail (S1 hand-built ant-* lookalikes pass the runtime checks, S2 .ant- selectors only checked at the start), Codex round 2 fixed source.test.ts; round 2 pass with one S2 (getPrefixCls / concatenated class names) written into the implementation brief as forbidden

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main
